purpose: Clearly-denominated local historical coverage measurement across all populations relevant to B2Z/2-hop/operation-discovery scaling. All numbers measured via bounded/indexed COUNT queries against the live committed databases -- zero provider calls, zero writes.

population_1_token_analysis.note_on_network_funder_address: essentially unpopulated at scale (0.023%) -- confirms this is NOT a viable shortcut for creator-funding evidence, consistent with the 20-member cohort finding (0/20 populated)

population_2_creator_funding_queue.note: roughly HALF of all enqueued creator-funding extraction jobs expired without completing -- a large, real, measured local-evidence gap at scale, not a hypothetical one

population_3_creator_funders.note: this is DERIVED_INFORMATION_ONLY tier (creator, funder, amount) -- no transaction_signature column, confirmed at full scale (see population_4 for the signature-bound surface)

population_4_transfer_index.note: the primary SIGNATURE_BOUND_NORMALIZED_EVIDENCE surface for both direct funding and 2-hop upstream discovery -- confirmed duplicate-free (PRIMARY-KEY-equivalent uniqueness on (signature, source, destination))

population_5_creator_inbound_transfers.note: CONFIRMED EMPTY AT FULL SCALE, not just for the 20-member cohort -- this table's extraction path (funder_incoming_extractor.py per docs/CLAUDE.md) has effectively never populated it in production despite having the correct schema (transaction_signature column present)

population_6_transaction_first_lineage_l.note: the system's own internal state model explicitly tracks 95.81% of this population as awaiting a future, rationed RPC budget -- direct architectural confirmation that blind universal verification was never the design

population_7_tf_transaction_cache.note: a dedicated raw-transaction cache, single-batch-imported (all rows share one fetched_at timestamp), NOT overlapping the 20-member B2N/B2Z cohort's specific signatures (confirmed 0 matches in P1.8)

population_8_tf_edges.note: every currently-materialized edge in this multi-hop graph IS raw-verified -- the system enforces Level-B evidence for edges it actually commits to topology, while leaving the vast majority of the launch population (population_6) unmaterialized pending selective RPC

population_9_tf_populations.note: 891 already-discovered structural population roots, 82 of which (REPEATED_TOPOLOGY + REPEATED_ROOT) represent multi-launch/multi-creator recurring structures -- direct input material for candidate operational family analysis (workstream 7)

top_fan_in_upstream_overall_including_ex.note: address name pattern matches the 'uses_axiom' creator_tags signal seen for ordinal 11's creator in P1.6/P1.7 -- corroborates this as a genuine, correctly-excluded trading-bot/service address, not a random hub

explicit_note_on_denominators: every ratio above is reported with both its numerator and denominator inline -- no bare percentage is presented without the counts that produced it, per instruction
measurement_method: all counts obtained via bounded/indexed SQLite COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT)/GROUP BY queries against the live committed databases in read-only mode; no provider calls; no writes; no schema changes
